basic_details.job_title: TMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) will hold a walk-in interview on 30 November 2026, with reporting from 09:30 A.M. to 10:30 A.M., at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam, Pincode:-530053. The interview is for 2 posts of Senior Resident in the Department of Radiation Oncology, open to Indian Nationals, with a consolidated remuneration of Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay) for MD/DNB holders and a tenure up to 31 July 2027 (Advertisement No. TMC/ADVT-165(E)/2026, dated 13 November 2026).

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation SC/ST 5 years OBC 3 years Physically Handicapped 10 years | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

qualification.details: The walk-in is for 2 posts of Senior Resident in the Department of Radiation Oncology. The essential qualification is MD (Radiation Oncology) OR equivalent PG degree. The consolidated remuneration is MD/DNB- Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay), and the appointment is for a tenure up to 31 July 2027. | The age limit is 40 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

important_instructions: The number of posts is likely to increase/decrease as per the requirement of the centre. Appointed candidates will be placed as per needs of the Departments of Tata Memorial Centre in its peripheral centre, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam. Preference will be given to candidates who agree to be placed in the Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam Centre only. Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation, subject to availability. Hostel charges of Rs.9,000/- will be deducted every month from the salary of Senior Residents. Doubts regarding the post may be clarified by email to [email protected] or by telephone at 0891-2871 538.

content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre is a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre at Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam is one of its peripheral centres, and the notice is signed by Prof S.S. Laskar, Director (Academics), TMC.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The walk-in is for 2 posts of Senior Resident in the Department of Radiation Oncology. The essential qualification is MD (Radiation Oncology) OR equivalent PG degree. The consolidated remuneration is MD/DNB- Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay), and the appointment is for a tenure up to 31 July 2027. The age limit is 40 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Detailed resume A recent passport size photograph Attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates For candidates working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations: a No Objection Certificate through the Head of their Institution, along with all original educational and experience certificates Candidates interested in the walk-in interview are requested to report directly to the hospital at Aganampudi on 30 November 2026 with these documents. No prior application is mentioned in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of posts is likely to increase/decrease as per the requirement of the centre. Appointed candidates will be placed as per needs of the Departments of Tata Memorial Centre in its peripheral centre, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam. Preference will be given to candidates who agree to be placed in the Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam Centre only. Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation, subject to availability. Hostel charges of Rs.9,000/- will be deducted every month from the salary of Senior Residents. Doubts regarding the post may be clarified by email to [email protected] or by telephone at 0891-2871 538.

faq.question: Q1. When is the TMC Senior Resident walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Senior Resident in Radiation Oncology is on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:30 A.M. and 10:30 A.M. at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam, Pincode:-530053.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Senior Resident in the Department of Radiation Oncology; the number is likely to increase/decrease as per the requirement of the centre.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for TMC Senior Resident (Radiation Oncology)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MD (Radiation Oncology) OR equivalent PG degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a TMC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is MD/DNB- Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay); hostel charges of Rs.9,000/- are deducted every month for Senior Residents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring a detailed resume, a recent passport size photograph and attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates; government and autonomous body employees must also bring an NOC through the Head of their Institution and all original certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The tenure of the Senior Resident post is up to 31 July 2027.

faq.question: Q9. Will accommodation be provided?
faq.answer: Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation subject to availability, and Rs.9,000/- hostel charges will be deducted every month from their salary.
